mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (course_name, course_code, credits, hours, dept_id, teacher_id, description, audit_status, status, capacity) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{courseCode}, #{credits}, #{hours}, #{deptId}, #{teacherId}, #{description}, #{auditStatus}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{capacity}, 50))
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET course_name = #{courseName}, course_code = #{courseCode}, credits = #{credits}, hours = #{hours}, dept_id = #{deptId}, description = #{description}, status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), capacity = COALESCE(#{capacity}, capacity), version = version + 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND COALESCE(#{capacity}, capacity) >= selected_count
UPDATE course SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, status = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND selected_count = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE audit_status = 1 AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET selected_count = selected_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1 AND selected_count < capacity
mapper.select:
SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credits, c.hours, c.dept_id, d.dept_name, u.real_name AS teacher_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN department d ON d.dept_id = c.dept_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = t.user_id
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.course_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET selected_count = selected_count - 1, version = version + 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND selected_count > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course
AND course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
